name: drawio-diagram-builder
title_zh: 截图丢进来，改到满意为止的 draw.io 图纸工
tagline_zh: 论文方法图、系统架构图，从提示词或截图直接生成可编辑 XML。改一轮不满意？截图回传，它接着改，直到你点头。
tagline_en: From prompt or screenshot to editable draw.io XML—method diagrams, architectures. Iterate by screenshot feedback.
desc_en: Create, edit, replicate, and iteratively refine editable research and technical diagrams in diagrams.net/draw.io (.drawio XML) from prompts, papers, repositories, screenshots, or existing diagrams. Use when asked to generate a scientific figure, paper method diagram, ML/system architecture diagram, draw.io file, reference figure reproduction, browser screenshot feedback loop, Windows-safe draw.io
why_zh: 不是一次性生成就撒手——它把浏览器截图当迭代信号，能复刻参考图结构，也能从论文/仓库反推图示。
why_en: Not a one-shot generator—it treats browser screenshots as iteration signals, replicates reference figures, and reverse-engineers.
limit_zh: 只认 draw.io 的 .drawio XML 格式，不输出 SVG/PNG 成品图。
limit_en: Outputs only .drawio XML, not rendered SVG/PNG; requires diagrams.net or desktop draw.io to view and screenshot for feedback.
title_en: Turn screenshots into editable draw.io diagrams, iteratively
